Method of Attack: Leveraging Microsoft SaaS services (Teams, SharePoint, Quick Assist, OneDrive) to distribute spear-phishing attacks and store malware
Using OneDrive-based Command & Control (C&C) method embedded in Java-based malware
Exploiting social engineering to gain access via Quick Assist
Using password-protected .zip files to deliver additional tools and malware
Impacted Systems: Critical infrastructure in the United States
Indicators of Compromise: UUID of the machine - Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_ComputerSystemProduct | Select-Object -ExpandProperty UUID
